body_lead: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on February 24 said that the state, which has country’s financial capital Mumbai, is also set to become the leader in artificial intelligence (AI). The state accounts for nearly 60 percent of the India’s data centres created in Navi Mumbai, he said. Fadnavis was speaking at the tech industry body Nasscom’s flagship event, Nasscom Technology and Leadership Forum 2025 in Mumbai. He shared that MoUs (Memorandum of understanding) worth $20 billion to build data centres were signed at the World Economic Forum in Davos last month.
